findings.problem: The record pairs the +/-0.2 degree tolerance with claim 16's three-of-nine threshold to imply the claim cannot exclude the excluded form B, but on the printed tables form B satisfies only two of claim 16's nine reflections and therefore falls outside the claim.
findings.artifact_says: with a tolerance of ±0.2° and a threshold of three reflections out of nine, only the full diffraction pattern distinguishes the claimed form from the excluded one at the low-angle end
findings.should_be: State the count. Taking the form B table at lines 335 to 353 (5.6, 9.2, 11.2, 12.7, 15.4, 18.5, 22.6, 25.5) against claim 16's nine windows, only 5.6 (exact) and 11.2 (inside 11.1±0.2) match; 9.2 misses 8.9±0.2 by 0.1 and 18.5 misses 18.9±0.2 by 0.2. Two matches is one short of the three-of-nine threshold, so claim 16 does exclude form B on the printed data. The genuine narrower point, that the first reflections of A and B are nearly coincident, should be kept and the threshold argument dropped.

findings.problem: The record's central distinction between the two processes, slow crystallization for form A against rapid cooling for form C, is contradicted by the document's own cooling-rate numbers, and that inconsistency is nowhere recorded.
findings.quote: [0031] If the crystallization of form A is effected by cooling, the cooling rate is preferably less than 10 K/min.
findings.artifact_says: under conditions in which "the conditions of the crystallization are chosen to achieve a slow crystallization rate" ([0014], line 165) ... with crystallization effected by rapid cooling
findings.should_be: Record that the two stated windows overlap completely: [0031] line 201 puts form A at less than 10 K/min, that is less than 600 K/hr, while [0056] line 311 puts rapid cooling for form C at "a cooling rate of at least 30 K/hr, for example at a cooling rate of 30 to 120 K/hr", that is 0.5 to 2 K/min. The entire preferred form C window lies inside the preferred form A window, so the document's stated cooling rates do not separate the two processes at all.

findings.problem: The record asserts as its sharpest evidence that the process and not the solvent controls the form, but the example tables show the solvent changing the form with the cooling regime held fixed.
findings.quote: [0073] 150 mg of tembotrione were dissolved in 0.15 ml of boiling methanol in a test vessel. The test vessel was sealed and placed in an ice-water bath and left there for about 40 mins.
findings.artifact_says: The sharpest single piece of evidence that the process and not the solvent controls the form is a comparison the patent does not itself draw
findings.should_be: Weaken or drop the generalisation. Under one identical regime, boiling solution, sealed vessel, ice-water bath, about 40 mins, methanol gives form A (Example 1, line 374), 2,2-dimethylpropanol gives form C (Example 14, line 426) and n-pentanol gives form B (Comparative Example 1, line 443). With the regime fixed the solvent alone selects the form, so the document supports only the weaker claim that regime and solvent both matter.

findings.problem: The claim that the cooling regime is the only variable between Example 14 and Comparative Example 16 is unsupported, because the charge, the concentration and the standing time differ too.
findings.quote: [0076] 150 mg of tembotrione were dissolved in 0.50 ml of boiling 2,2-dimethylpropanol in a test vessel. The test vessel was sealed and placed in an ice-water bath and left there for about 40 mins.
findings.artifact_says: so the variable between them is the cooling regime alone
findings.should_be: Drop the word alone. Example 14 is a defined charge of 150 mg in 0.50 ml, about 300 g/l, held 40 mins; Comparative Example 16 is one row of "A saturated solution of about 50 mg of tembotrione" (line 479) left overnight. Cooling regime, concentration and time all differ.

findings.problem: Example 14 is described as giving pure form C, but the example reports only that form C was identified and no example in the document reports a polymorph content.
findings.quote: In this manner, tembotrione was obtained in the form of crystalline prisms, which were isolated and analyzed by X-ray powder diffractometry (XRD). On the basis of the characteristic reflections, form C was identified.
findings.artifact_says: while Example 14 uses that same solvent with an ice-water bath and gives pure form C (line 426)
findings.should_be: "gives form C". The word pure is a defined term in this document, at least 90 wt. % of the modification per [0008] line 90, and no example measures it.

findings.problem: The absolute assertion that no bond is formed or broken anywhere in the document is contradicted by [0021], which offers preparation of the tembotrione by chemical reaction as one of the two ways to obtain the solution.
findings.quote: [0021] (2) Preparation of the tembotrione by a chemical reaction and transfer of the reaction mixture, if necessary after removal of reagents and/or side products, into an organic solvent suitable according to the invention.
findings.artifact_says: No bond is formed or broken anywhere in the document and no synthesis is disclosed
findings.should_be: Keep "no synthesis is disclosed", which is right, and qualify the first clause: the document contemplates a bond-forming step at [0021] line 179 and [0024] line 185 but discloses no procedure for it, referring it out to WO 00/21924.

findings.problem: The statement that no chemical assay purity appears anywhere is contradicted by [0039] and [0062], which state a tembotrione content for the product of the crystallization, and by claims 17 and 21.
findings.quote: [0039] By means of the crystallization according to the invention, the form A is obtained with a tembotrione content of as a rule at least 90 wt. %, often 94 wt. %, in particular at least 96 wt. %.
findings.artifact_says: no yield, no isolated product mass and no chemical assay purity appears anywhere
findings.should_be: Narrow the scope to the examples: no yield, no isolated mass and no measured assay is reported for any individual preparation, while [0039] line 218 and [0062] line 323 do state a general tembotrione content for the isolated form.

findings.problem: The assertion that only claims 16 and 20 are independent applies a reference-to-another-claim test that does not hold for the claims of different statutory class.
findings.quote: 19 19. A process for the production of the crystalline form A of claim 16, comprising:
findings.artifact_says: so the live claims are 16 to 33 and only 16 and 20 are independent
findings.should_be: Claims 19 and 23 (process), 24 and 28 (agent) and 32 and 33 (method of use) refer to claim 16 or 20 but claim a different statutory class and are independent in substance; the dependent claims are 17, 18, 21, 22, 25 to 27 and 29 to 31. Either say "only 16 and 20 do not refer to another claim" or count the eight independent claims.

findings.problem: The flat statement that form C crystallization is effected by rapid cooling omits the document's own exception, and the only gram-scale preparation in the document does not use rapid cooling.
findings.quote: [0056] ... This is understood to mean that the solution is cooled at a cooling rate of at least 30 K/hr, for example at a cooling rate of 30 to 120 K/hr. Rapid cooling is not necessary, when seed crystals of form C are used.
findings.artifact_says: with crystallization effected by rapid cooling
findings.should_be: Add the exception. Example 15 at line 437, the one preparation above milligram scale, cooled on an oil bath to 101 degrees C, added form C seed crystals, cooled to room temperature and stored overnight at 6 degrees C, which is the seeded route of [0056] and not rapid cooling.

findings.problem: The three X-ray powder diffractograms are characterisation data of the document and are not mentioned at all, including that one of the three sheets belongs to the excluded form B.
findings.quote: [0069] FIG. 2 shows an X-ray powder diffraction diagram of form B. The X-ray diffraction diagram was recorded under the conditions stated for FIG. 1.
findings.should_be: One clause recording that the two drawing sheets carry FIG. 1 (form A), FIG. 2 (form B) and FIG. 3 (form C), [0068] to [0070] at lines 360 to 364, recorded on a Bruker-AXS D-5000 in reflection geometry over 2 theta = 2 to 40 degrees.

findings.problem: patent_summary is 461 words in roughly nine sentences where the A4 prompt allows one to two sentences.
findings.quote: [0001] The present invention relates to two crystalline forms of 2-[2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)benzoyl]cyclohexan-1,3-dione, which is also known under the common name tembotrione.

findings.problem: novelty_claims is 1606 words in roughly thirty sentences where the A4 prompt allows two to four sentences.
findings.quote: [0007] It has now surprisingly been found that by suitable processes two previously unknown crystalline, stable modifications of tembotrione which do not display the disadvantages of the amorphous tembotrione are obtained in high purity.
findings.should_be: Cut to the two to four sentences rule 2 requires: what is claimed as new, the [0003] and [0006] objections it answers, and the fact that the [0008] formulation stability advantage carries no experiment. The remaining material belongs in the run notes.

findings.problem: novelty_claims closes with commentary about the annotation's own tag vocabulary rather than about what the patent positions as new.
findings.quote: [0007] ... two previously unknown crystalline, stable modifications of tembotrione which do not display the disadvantages of the amorphous tembotrione are obtained in high purity. These two modifications are also described below as form A and form C.
findings.artifact_says: Finally, on the closed tag lists: the substance-of-matter novelty this patent actually asserts, a previously unknown crystalline form of a known compound, has no value in the permitted novelty list, and new_compound would be wrong because no new compound is made, so only novelty:new_process is emitted and the form novelty is left untagged rather than approximated.
findings.should_be: Delete the sentence from the deliverable field and record the reasoning in the run notes. The field should say what the patent asserts as new, which is the solid form itself.

findings.problem: The novelty category carries only new_process, but two listed values arguably fit the positioning the document itself states.
findings.quote: [0007] It has now surprisingly been found that by suitable processes two previously unknown crystalline, stable modifications of tembotrione ... are obtained in high purity.

checks_passed.check: fidelity, the crystalline form distinctions, checked independently
checks_passed.what_was_verified: Built the discrimination matrix by hand from the three reflection tables at lines 97 to 105 (A), 227 to 233 (C) and 335 to 353 (B) against the claim windows at lines 714 and 753. Against claim 16, form C matches none of the nine, its nearest approach being 10.8 against 11.1 plus or minus 0.2, and form B matches two. Against claim 20, form A matches none of the seven, nearest 11.1 against 10.8 plus or minus 0.2, and form B matches none. So the tabulated powder data and the claim thresholds do discriminate all three modifications cleanly, in both directions, and the record's XRPD scepticism is overstated (see the first finding). The DSC data by contrast does not discriminate: onsets are A 118 to 124, B 118 to 123 and C 121 to 125 degrees C at lines 161, 354 and 284, so A and B are indistinguishable by onset, which is what the record says and it is right. The single-crystal data discriminate A from C decisively, orthorhombic Pna2(1) against monoclinic P2(1)/n, and there is no single-crystal data for form B anywhere in the document, so form B rests on powder plus DSC alone.

Grepped the whole document for yield, purity, stability and percentage-of-theory language and read every example and table. There is genuinely no yield, no isolated mass and no per-example assay anywhere, and no formulation stability trial: the only stability data are [0083] to [0086] at lines 525 to 531. The record's account of those four paragraphs, including that a mixture containing B goes to A while B alone goes to C and that the document reconciles neither, is accurate and correctly left unresolved.
